versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill for modular development of complex apps, following five core scientific principles.
- Provides clear guidelines for when and how to apply modularization, from new builds to refactoring.
- Details each core development principle, including process establishment, module independence, code/data locking, sequential testing, and global verification.
- Includes a reference framework for typical app modules, sample workflows, code/data locking mechanisms, and data-sharing standards.
- Offers supporting scripts and documentation templates for design, API specification, testing, and delivery.
